SEO + discovery overhaul. Description compressed from 4-paragraph wall to 1 line surfacing concrete proof points (10 stories, named RSS sources, financial-impact emoji, 2h breaking cadence, multi-channel push). Keywords trimmed 73 → 29 (drop duplicates, add KR/JA/VN long-tail). New 'When to invoke' block at top of SKILL.md body with EN voice queries. NewsToday v2.3.1

- Documentation updates: README.md and SKILL.md were revised for clarity and completeness.
- No feature or functionality changes—this release is documentation only.

- Updated dependencies in package.json to ensure compatibility and improved maintenance.
- No changes to user-facing features or documentation.

- Updated dependencies in package.json for improved compatibility and stability.
- No functional or user-facing changes to the skill behavior.

- Major update: NewsToday now delivers personalized, deduplicated news briefs and breaking alerts across multiple platforms.
- Aggregates top 10 daily stories from leading RSS feeds and WebSearch, with two-line summaries and source attribution.
- Offers tailored morning briefings, evening recaps, breaking news alerts, and topic tracking with user-set preferences.
- Supports multi-platform delivery including Telegram, Feishu, Slack, and Discord; no registration required for immediate use.
- Enhanced hot topic aggregation from Weibo, Zhihu, Baidu, and X, with automatic fallback if data is unavailable.
- Improved user controls for topic weighting, push scheduling, and language choice (Chinese or English).
